children: Apple (AAPL) sees ~75%+ gross margins in Services, a major profit driver. Key revenue sources: App Store sales and an annual Google payment topping $20 billion for default search.
Apple (AAPL) named John Ternus as CEO, replacing Tim Cook. No operational details or timing were provided. Traders note executive change; monitor stock and options for reaction.
Apple (AAPL) plans bigger AI and R&D spending, may seek larger acquisitions and drop a cash-neutral target to fund growth and future capabilities.
Apple (AAPL) shifting U.S.-bound device production: most iPhones to be assembled in India by end of 2026; some AirPods and iPads planned for assembly in Vietnam.
Apple sued OpenAI, alleging trade-secret theft tied to ex-employees Tang Tan and Chang Liu. OpenAI called the claims baseless, blaming Apple’s onboarding/offboarding and data-handling practices.
Apple (AAPL) sees Mac mini and high‑memory desktop shortages and backorders as developers and power users buy these models to build local AI servers using Apple Silicon’s unified memory.
Ahead of Sept. 9 launch, Apple (AAPL) CEO sounded unusually bullish. Traders note potential upside for AAPL from strong post-launch preorders; supplier demand could signal higher device sales.
Rosenblatt Securities maintained its Neutral rating on Apple Inc. (AAPL) and raised its price target to $303 per share from $300, noting the updated valuation while keeping the same rating.
Apple (AAPL) returned about 24.9% annually under CEO Tim Cook over 15 years and added over $4 trillion in market value, without launching a major new hit product or proving AI leadership.
